targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days'
SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM instance_meta
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM instance_meta WHERE first_seen >= current_date - interval '7 days'
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS active FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT first_seen::timestamptz AS time, count(*) AS new_instances FROM instance_meta WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen::timestamptz) GROUP BY first_seen ORDER BY first_seen
SELECT (payload->>'platform') AS platform, count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS instances FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY instances DESC
SELECT (payload->>'os_family') AS os, count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS instances FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY instances DESC

SELECT (payload->'counts'->>'accounts') AS bucket, count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS instances FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2-5' THEN 2 WHEN '6-10' THEN 3 WHEN '11-50' THEN 4 WHEN '51-200' THEN 5 WHEN '201+' THEN 6 ELSE 9 END

panels.title: Version distribution (latest snapshot per instance, last 7d)

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC) SELECT (payload->>'version') AS version, count(*) AS instances FROM latest GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY instances DESC LIMIT 25

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC), agg AS (SELECT count(*)::float AS total, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'calendar')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calendar, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'contacts')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contacts, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'files')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS files, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'extensions')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS extensions, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'push_relay')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS push_relay, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'oauth_enabled')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oauth, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'smime_enabled')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smime, sum(CASE WHEN (payload->'features'->>'webdav_enabled')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS webdav FROM latest) SELECT 'calendar' AS feature, calendar/NULLIF(total,0) AS pct FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'contacts', contacts/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'files', files/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'extensions', extensions/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'push_relay', push_relay/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'oauth_enabled', oauth/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'smime_enabled', smime/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'webdav_enabled', webdav/NULLIF(total,0) FROM agg ORDER BY pct DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Recent heartbeats (last 50 raw - only if not yet aggregated out)

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at, day, payload->>'version' AS version, payload->>'platform' AS platform, payload->>'os_family' AS os, payload->'counts'->>'accounts' AS accounts FROM heartbeats ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50
